text:
sophie_finance: Quick check \u2014 NebulaEmbed sent a "serverless" pricing appendix for embeddings and a separate reserved GPU commit sheet. There's ambiguity on invoicing and how they count "active vectors". Can procurement/ops/ML eyeball before I escalate?

leo_procure: Paste the bits that look off.

sophie_finance: Key excerpts they sent:

```
Serverless embedding: $0.00085 per vector-hour OR $0.000015 per vector-request (mode selected per workload).
Reserved GPU: $5.50 per vGPU-hr with 10% reserved discount and burst at 1.75x after 125% usage.
Invoice cadence: monthly in USD to UK entity (FX risk).
Price experiment clause: vendor may run price "optimizations" +/-10% with 30d notice.
Onboarding: $8k one-time non-refundable.
```

mina_ml: The two-mode pricing again \u2014 per-vector-hour vs per-request. If their vector-hour counts unique vectors kept in memory, long-running pipelines could blow up. Need a precise definition.

aj_ops: Also need to confirm whether cache/KV hits are billed. Our batch pipeline relies heavily on cached embeddings for rerank. If cache hits are billed, we can't move forward.

rachel_legal: From contract POV: remove unilateral price-change rights. At minimum: require written agreement for increases or allow termination for material changes in first 12 months. Also need invoice in USD to our US entity or fixed FX protection for 12 months.

nebularep: Hi all \u2014 quick clarifications: we bill vector-hour as "emitted unique vectors per hour". Cache hits to our managed KV are not billed; customer-managed KV reads are not billed either. Price experiments are normally tests but we can provide price-lock for 12 months for enterprise customers. Sample invoice available on request.

mina_ml: Thanks \u2014 can you provide the hashing/deduping algorithm spec (how you compute "unique") and a sample invoice for a 50k-request batched job with 20% cache hits so we can reconcile?

nebularep: Yes, will provide hashing spec and sample invoice. We dedupe using stable 64-bit hash on normalized vectors; near-duplicates within epsilon are considered distinct unless quantized. We'll send examples.

sophie_finance: Finance asks: 1) onboarding fee convertible to usage credit if commit tier reached within 60 days, 2) invoice line-itemization mapping SKUs to GL codes, 3) Net-30 preferred (they propose Net-45).

leo_procure: Procurement asks: pilot PO cap option (we prefer $25k), ability to opt-out of overages via console toggle, and a capped exposure during pilot (max $10k overage).

aj_ops: Ops asks: monthly CSV + API for raw usage, and webhook alerts when burst > 100% so we can auto-fallback. Also need guarantee that burst overage calculation is done daily (not hourly) so short spikes don't create massive charges.

rachel_legal: Legal will draft language for: price-lock 12 months, audit right quarterly to reconcile vector-hours (discrepancy >2% triggers adjustment), SLA credits applied as invoice line-item automatically, and termination right for material price hikes.

nebularep: We can accept: pilot PO cap, console overage opt-out, API access for enterprise, and will provide sample invoices. Price-lock for 12 months is acceptable if contract signed. We typically allow audit once per quarter with NDA.

mina_ml: One more technical: confirm whether their "serverless" per-request mode rounds up vectors for batched inference or charges on exact emitted count. In our tests billing rounding logic changes cost by ~8%.

nebularep: Serverless per-request mode charges exact emitted vectors; no rounding up at the request level. We'll include billing rounding rules in the spec.

sophie_finance: OK next steps: 1) Leo will draft procurement asks and pilot PO cap offer, 2) Mina will compile telemetry sample and expected cost scenarios (best/worst), 3) Rachel will prepare contract redlines for price protection and audit, 4) Nebula rep to share hashing spec + sample invoices + usage API doc. Target sending consolidated ask by EOD tomorrow.

procurement_bot: Reminder: attach vendor appendix, sample invoices, and usage API docs to Confluence under vendor-evals/NebulaEmbed. Decision milestone 2024-10-15.

leo_procure: Will draft and circulate in ~3 hours. ping me for urgent edits.

sophie_finance: Thanks everyone \u2014 let's not sign onboarding fee as non-refundable until commit language is clarified. :thumbsup:
